Signed-off-by: Sherif Waly <sherif.waly@mistral.ai>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py::ModelAclGraphManager (subclasses vllm.v1.worker.gpu.cudagraph_utils.ModelCudaGraphManager and inherits CudaGraphManager._init_candidates / _capture_descs)

vllm_ascend/ops/triton/kda/recoverssm.py::kda_recoverssm_verify and KDARecoverSSMCommitContext (fixed spec_query_len / 'activation capacity' check)
vllm_ascend/ops/gdn_attn_builder.py::AscendGDNHostMetadataBuilder and the upcoming Qwen GDN RecoverSSM metadata path (same RecoverSSM class of kernels)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py, ModelAclGraphManager now inherits the uncapped CudaGraphManager._init_candidates. Confirm that the extra mixed descriptors (num_tokens > max_num_seqs * uniform_decode_query_len) produced with cache_config.use_kda_recoverssm=True are intended; collect_sorted_captured_token_sizes()/set_graph_params(self.capture_sizes) will now register these larger token sizes for ACL graph params, and the FULL/PIECEWISE capture set and graph-pool memory grow accordingly. If Ascend's RecoverSSM/ACL graph pool cannot handle them, override _init_candidates in ModelAclGraphManager (or filter _capture_descs / prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes before set_graph_params) to re-apply the old num_tokens <= max_num_seqs * uniform_decode_query_len cap when use_kda_recoverssm is set. 2) In AscendKDARecoverSSMMetadataBuilder.build (vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/recoverssm_metadata.py) and AscendKimiKDARecoverSSMMetadataBuilder (vllm_ascend/models/kimi_k3/recoverssm_metadata.py), verify that rows with query length > num_spec+1 are excluded from spec_sequence_masks before calling the upstream KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder.build. vllm-ascend sets for_capture=False for PIECEWISE capture, so wide capture dummies look like non-prefill decode rows; without the upstream routing mask (query_start_loc_cpu.diff() <= num_spec+1, added in vLLM 9c345f0951) they reach the RecoverSSM verify path and the Ascend kernels raise the 'KDA RecoverSSM speculative decode query length exceeds its activation capacity' ValueError. Keep the existing lengths <= num_spec+1 filter in _non_spec_cpu_starts and, if vllm-ascend is pinned to a vLLM revision before the routing fix, apply that mask locally before super().build(), or keep the cap in ModelAclGraphManager. 3) Re-check vllm_ascend/ops/triton/kda/recoverssm.py: kda_recoverssm_verify/KDARecoverSSMCommitContext keep a per-request spec_query_len (=1+num_spec) window, which is valid only if wide rows are routed to the non-spec prefill path; no buffer resize should be needed once routing is confirmed. 4) Apply the same rule to the GDN RecoverSSM work (Qwen GDN framework integration): upstream PR #67903 explicitly notes GDN RecoverSSM must keep the cap unless its metadata builder routes wide rows to non-spec. 5) Extend tests/ut/worker/v2/test_aclgraph.py (which currently builds the native _init_candidates case with use_kda_recoverssm=False) with a RecoverSSM case asserting the expanded mixed capture sizes and that wide dummy rows take the non-spec path, and validate ACL/CANN graph capture memory accounting on NPU.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. The change is inherited automatically and is safe only while the three upstream preconditions hold (per-request RecoverSSM capacity, wide rows routed to the non-spec path by KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder, and KDA _forward as an eager break during replay). vllm-ascend keeps a downstream copy of the RecoverSSM verify/commit kernels and its own metadata builder, and its pinned/verified vLLM revision predates the wide-row routing fix, so a version skew or a missing local filter would fail startup graph capture with the RecoverSSM activation-capacity ValueError. Capturing all mixed graphs also increases ACL graph count and NPU graph-pool memory/capture time (upstream measured ~0.57 GiB/rank extra); if that budget is not provisioned the first capture can OOM. deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
Runtime production code should remain compatible because vllm-ascend already uses torch.Stream, torch.Event, and torch.accelerator.current_stream on NPU (e.g. vllm_ascend/hisparse/host_mirror.py and distributed/eplb). Required work is mainly test adaptation plus validation:
1. Update tests/ut/worker/test_adaptive_verification.py::cpu_manager_resources. Upstream AdaptiveVerificationManager now creates torch.Event(blocking=True, device=...), uses new_d2h_stream() -> torch.Stream, and calls torch.accelerator.current_stream(self.req_states.device) instead of torch.cuda.Event/Stream/current_stream. Patch the generic symbols (torch.Event, torch.Stream, torch.accelerator.current_stream; keep the existing adaptive.stream -> nullcontext patch) in addition to or instead of the torch.cuda patches. Version-gate with vllm_version_is("0.33.0") if the same test must still run against the older upstream implementation that uses torch.cuda.*.
2. Validate on the pinned torch-npu that torch.accelerator.set_stream (now used by async_utils.stream()) routes to torch.npu.set_stream and that torch.Event(blocking=True, device=torch.device("npu:...")) works. If stream routing is missing, extend vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_torch_accelerator.py (currently only memory APIs) with torch.accelerator.set_stream = torch.npu.set_stream and ensure it is installed before worker/model-runner initialization.
3. Do not remove vllm_ascend/worker/v2/utils.py::torch_cuda_wrapper: other upstream paths still use torch.cuda APIs (e.g. GPUModelRunner.main_stream, vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py postprocess_sampled, sparse_hccl_engine._broadcast_chunk). Only the D2H copy path now bypasses it.
4. Check vllm_ascend/hisparse/host_mirror.py::overlap_target_host_mirror: runner.output_copy_stream is now a generic torch.Stream rather than torch.npu.Stream. It reads stream_id/device_index/device_type and reconstructs torch.Stream, which generic torch.Stream supports, so no change is expected, but add/execute a hisparse overlap test to confirm.
5. Run tests/ut/worker/test_adaptive_verification.py, tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2.py, tests/ut/runtime_guard, and a targeted MRV2 spec-decode (adaptive verification + structured output, and a dflash/dspark case) on NPU.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. The main runtime risk is whether the pinned torch-npu/2.10.0.post7 fully routes torch.accelerator.set_stream and device-scoped torch.Event to NPU; if it does not, the D2H copy stream/event ordering could silently regress (copies observed before completion, or stream-context not applied), which is more dangerous than an immediate exception. The existing uses of torch.accelerator.current_stream, torch.Stream, and torch.Event in vllm-ascend make this unlikely. The concrete known breakage is CPU-only unit tests: after this commit, monkeypatching torch.cuda.* no longer intercepts the adaptive-verification manager, and torch.Event(device=cpu)/torch.accelerator.current_stream(cpu) can fail on hosts without an accelerator. Fixing the fixture avoids CI failures; no broad production rewrite is needed.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
1) vllm_ascend/platform.py: add NPUPlatform.supports_eplb() returning True and NPUPlatform.check_and_update_eplb_config(parallel_config). Move Ascend EPLB policy/communicator selection and validation into that hook: normalize policy None to 'stair' (or the intended Ascend default), validate 'default'/'stair', preserve explicitly configured communicators, auto-select 'hixl' vs 'torch_gloo' consistently with resolve_ascend_eplb_communicator/_AUTO_SELECTED_ATTRIBUTE, keep the async restriction (reject torch_nccl/pynccl, allow hixl/gloo), and retain the NPU-specific EPLB restrictions currently in _validate_eplb_config/platform _fix_incompatible_config. The existing _CudaAlikeEplbPlatformProxy is no longer sufficient because the new gate calls supports_eplb(), not is_cuda_alike().

2) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py: fix import-time breakages before anything else. _patch_eplb_policy_config must stop looking up the removed EPLBConfig._validate_eplb_config pydantic validator; adapt to the new policy typing (str | None) and either extend the field/new platform hook or drop the patch. _patch_parallel_config must delegate supports_eplb and check_and_update_eplb_config (or be removed once NPUPlatform implements them), and must not let the base hook overwrite the provisional hixl/gloo choice. _patch_async_move_to_workspace must patch vllm.distributed.eplb.eplb_state.EplbModelState._move_to_workspace (unbound method) instead of the removed module function, and _wrap_move_to_workspace must bind 'self'/'ep_rank' rather than 'model_state'/'ep_rank'. Keep the explicit-transfer target, deferred consumed-event acknowledgement, routing-table refresh and predicted-ratio bookkeeping intact. _wrap_async_rebalance must build a new EplbStats (ideally an Ascend subclass carrying PreparedLoadStats/sample_counts/rank_node_ids) and call policy.rebalance_experts(stats, current_mapping, last_committed_mean_ratios=..., rank_node_ids=...) instead of the old positional signature. _patch_communicator_factory can remain on create_eplb_communicator, but prefer overriding AscendEplbState.create_model_communicator.

3) vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/eplb_state.py: override AscendEplbState.create_policy() so it returns the configured policy instance (from create_eplb_policy / self._configured_policy) without depending on EPLB_POLICIES being populated during super().__init__; upstream now calls create_policy() in EplbState.__init__ and later instantiates EPLB_POLICIES[name]() with no arguments, which is incompatible with the current transient instance registration and with StairEplbPolicy(stair_config). Update _configured_upstream_policy/from_mapping accordingly (register a class/factory, not an instance, or rely on create_policy). Replace _eplb_state.EplbStats with EplbStats imported from vllm.distributed.eplb.policy, and update publish_async_load_stats/collect_global_load_stats/from_mapping to construct/consume the new stats form. Prefer defining an AscendEplbStats(EplbStats) subclass carrying PreparedLoadStats fields, sample_counts and rank_node_ids, since the new interface explicitly permits subclass snapshots. Optionally set model_state_cls or override create_model_communicator for Ascend communicators.

4) vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/policy/stair.py: change StairEplbPolicy.rebalance_experts to (self, stats: EplbStats, old_global_expert_indices=None, *, last_committed_mean_ratios=None, rank_node_ids=None), reading num_replicas/num_groups/num_nodes/num_gpus from stats and the prepared load values/sample counts from the Ascend stats subclass. Keep a compatibility path if needed for direct unit tests, but the upstream planner will only pass the stats object.

5) vllm_ascend/distributed/eplb/policy/factory.py and vllm_ascend/worker/v2/eplb.py: handle policy=None explicitly (NPU default should be set by the platform hook before create_eplb_policy), and ensure AscendEPLBController constructs AscendEplbState with the new create_policy/extension hooks rather than transient registry mutation.

6) Update unit tests and contracts: tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_eplb.py (old call_args expectation (2,1,2,2,physical_map); new _move_to_workspace target), tests/ut/distributed/eplb/policy/test_stair.py (old positional rebalance_experts calls), tests/ut/distributed/eplb/test_state.py and test_policy_load_stats.py (EPLB_POLICIES/create_policy/EplbStats behavior), and tests/ut/test_platform.py for the new supports_eplb/check_and_update_eplb_config hook.
deep_analysis.risk: High. The patch module vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_eplb.py is imported as part of platform patch initialization, so the removed _validate_eplb_config validator and removed module-level _move_to_workspace cause immediate RuntimeError/AttributeError and prevent EPLB (and possibly the whole plugin startup path that imports the platform patches) from initializing. Even if import is fixed, AscendEplbState.__init__ will fail to construct the 'stair' policy because upstream now calls create_policy() during __init__ while the registry is empty (KeyError) or holds a policy instance (TypeError on EPLB_POLICIES[name]()). The reduced EplbStats relocation and new policy signature would cause runtime TypeError/AttributeError in both synchronous and asynchronous planning. An incomplete platform hook adaptation can silently select the base 'default' policy or an unavailable communicator (nixl/torch_gloo) on NPU, or incorrectly reject enable_eplb because supports_eplb() returns False for PlatformEnum.OOT. Async EPLB is the most sensitive area: a mis-adapted _move_to_workspace wrapper can break consumed-event acknowledgement ordering, explicit HIXL transfer targets, routing-table refresh, or cause collective hangs/incorrect expert placement. Thorough EPLB unit tests plus two-card/four-card MRV2 EPLB and HIXL end-to-end tests are required before upgrade.

commits.comment: 修复 ROCM_AITER_FA 在乱序 batch 下的 context 丢失：当无上下文的 fresh prompt 排在带上下文的 extend 之前时，旧的 chunked-context-prefill 逻辑按 `_CP_TOKENS_PER_ITER_ROCM // num_extends` 平均分配 workspace，把预算分给了不读 context 的请求，导致真正需要读 context 的 extend 被过度切块甚至读不到。修复分两层：`vllm/v1/attention/backends/rocm_aiter_fa.py` 改为 `num_extends_with_context = max(int((computed_kv_lens > 0).sum()), 1)`，只在实际有 context 的 extends 间瓜分 workspace。更关键的是平台无关的 `vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py::split_decodes_prefills_and_extends` 被重写：decode 段改为“真实 query_lens 的前导连续段”（query_lens 用 `query_start_loc[1:num_reqs+1]` 精确切片），先处理 `is_decode.all()` 以避免 stale `max_query_len` 把全 decode batch 误判为有 extends；extends/prefills 的划分改用 `seq_lens > query_lens` 的 has_context，并从尾部反向定位最后一个带 context 的请求作为 prefill 起点，从而不再假设 batch 已被重排。测试侧新增三处覆盖：`test_attention_splitting.py` 的三分切分用例（fresh prompt 排在 extend 前、draft token 抬高 max_query_len 的全 decode 场景）、`test_cp_utils.py` 中 stale max_query_len 不得触发 DCP split gate 的用例、以及 ROCm 上的 AITER FA 乱序 batch 端到端正确性用例。风险在于该 helper 是跨后端的共享工具，虽签名与返回元组 `(num_decodes, num_extends, num_prefills, ...)` 未变，但边界语义有实质变更（原先依赖 argmax 的“已重排”假设），所有复用它的 metadata builder 都需要复核。

ascend_impact.functionality: 修改的是平台无关的 `vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils.split_decodes_prefills_and_extends`（以及被 `vllm.v1.worker.cp_utils` 复用的切分语义），Vllm-ascend 的 `AscendAttentionMetadataBuilder` 及其 DCP/PCP 子类路径在构建 decodes/extends/prefills 三元切分时依赖该工具。函数签名与返回元组不变，但 decodes 改为真实 query_lens 的前导连续段、extends/prefills 以 `seq_lens > query_lens` 的 has_context 从尾部反向定位，因此原先“batch 已被重排（extends 在前、prefills 在后）”的假设不再成立；若 Ascend 侧存在依赖旧 argmax 语义的 metadata 构建或 DCP context 切分判断，需要同步按新语义复核。`rocm_aiter_fa.py` 的 workspace 分摊修改为 ROCm 专有路径，与 Ascend 无关。
ascend_impact.testing: 上游新增了 `tests/v1/attention/test_attention_splitting.py::test_split_decodes_prefills_and_extends`（fresh prompt 排在 extend 之前、draft token 抬高 max_query_len 的全 decode batch）与 `tests/v1/worker/test_cp_utils.py::test_split_dcp_context_queries_counts_a_stale_max_query_len_batch`（stale max_query_len 不得错误置位 split gate）。这两类场景需要纳入 vllm-ascend 的 metadata builder 与 DCP/PCP 相关单测覆盖范围；ROCm 专用的 `test_rocm_aiter_fa_unordered_batch` 无需移植。
